Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator failed to correctly identify the available tools in the environment. Specifically, the team description clearly listed a "ComputerTerminal" agent capable of running Python scripts, which is the most appropriate and reliable method for fetching large historical datasets (like daily max temps for 4 years) from APIs (e.g., NOAA's API) or processing data. Instead of assigning this task to the ComputerTerminal to write a script, the Orchestrator assigned all web navigation and data extraction tasks to the WebSurfer. This led to the WebSurfer getting stuck in a loop trying to manually navigate complex web forms on Weather Underground and NOAA CDO, which is inefficient and prone to failure for multi-year data extraction. The error occurred at the very first step of planning and task assignment.
